verdict.rationale: Tuning index parameters is a fair question for a vector database, but nothing in the evidence shows Pinecone exposing HNSW graph settings, index-type choices, or recall/latency/memory trade-off controls. The only related items are a community remark that Pinecone had HNSW (with no mention of tunable parameters) and backup docs mentioning 'experiment with configurations'. Both are adjacent and do not show the tuning capability itself.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can tune index parameters (HNSW graph settings, index types) to trade recall against latency and memory
